controls.method: Unchanged original cosine_q function extracted and compiled with rustc 1.98.1; five authored tests; no ONNX/image/network/NAS execution.

findings: cosine_q explicitly returns zero for empty, mismatched or zero-norm vectors; positive parallel, orthogonal and opposite vectors passed original-function controls.
Embedder uses fixed 224 center crop after shortest-side resize, RGB8 and CLIP normalization; no explicit EXIF autorotation, alpha compositing, frame or ICC contract in this module.

Output uses image_embeds if present, otherwise first model output without explicit expected vector dimension validation. Zero norm rejected; no explicit finite-value validation. These are source observations, not runtime counterexamples.
Model URL resolves mutable main revision and downloaded model has no expected digest check. Cached existing path accepted; no model fetched in this review.
Quantization rounds/clamps to signed 8-bit and base64; dimension/finite value validity not encoded by the cache string itself. Cache consumer assessment remains pending.
license: Root MIT fully read. Original cosine_q retained only in research control artifact; no production code adopted.
limits: No whole application build, model run, image-corpus precision, NAS account operation or deletion.
